rates.label: Per 100,000 residents (police precinct)

gaps.message: Reported crimes only: many crimes go unreported, and reporting differs between communities and crime types.
Police precincts don't follow ward boundaries. Figures are for the precinct(s) covering the ward, not crimes inside the ward itself.

Rates divide by residents. Precincts with many visitors or workers (the city centre, beachfronts, shopping areas) show higher rates than their residents experience. No rate is given for precincts with very few residents or that reach past the population data.

precincts.licence: Derived table; the SAPS boundaries themselves are not redistributed
precincts.notes: SAPS station boundaries version 1.4.2, downloaded by hand under SAPS terms and kept out of the repository. share_of_ward = share of the ward's residents (GHSL 2025 grid, scaled to the City's estimate) living in the precinct. precinct_population = the precinct's residents (same grid, inside or outside the metro); precinct_in_grid = share of the precinct's area inside the grid's box (18.2, -34.4, 19.1, -33.4) (below 1, the population is undercounted).
